title: 101 Ways to Die in a Hostel
subtitle: Overdose
series: 101 Ways to Die in a Hostel
tagline: Some hostels are a bargain. Others cost you your life.

synopsis.short: A burned-out tech executive seeking escape at a legendary party hostel dies from a fentanyl-laced cocaine overdose, never suspecting the drugs she bought from a "trusted" fellow traveler would be her last purchase.

death_teaser: She wanted to feel something. She felt everything. Then nothing.
